issue.title: Null pointer dereference in `II_setitem` via re-entrant `__index__` during `array.extend`

labels.name: extension-modules
labels.description: C modules in the Modules dir

labels.name: type-crash
labels.description: A hard crash of the interpreter, possibly with a core dump

comments.body:
Although this is not the same method, I think this null pointer dereference shares the same pattern as https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/142555.

In both cases, they accept a user defined argument that implements the `__index__` method, and we should check whether it changes the array in `*_setitem`.

I'm working on a PR https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/142713 that addresses all of these patterns.
Thank you, @aisk! Sounds great to me!
I'm going to consider this as a duplicate of #142555. All `*_set*` functions suffer from this I think (and maybe more), but let's only have one issue
